title: Promote message normalization into production core
objective: Repair normalize_provider_message in the production source package so Gmail-like synthetic provider messages are converted into the fixed provider-neutral shape. Read headers case-insensitively, preserve raw header values for later identity/authentication stages, and leave missing optional headers as null. Do not change the test.
acceptance_criteria: provider message and thread identifiers are preserved
From, To, Subject, Reply-To, Return-Path, List-ID, and Authentication-Results are read case-insensitively without semantic interpretation
label IDs and snippet are preserved
missing optional headers remain null rather than being inferred
the production acceptance test passes without modification
